macros.name: setRecipeColors
macros.doc: If you want to change the default colors, you can use setRecipeColors. The colors are set by <key = value> as known by the xkeyval package.

macros.name: setRecipeLengths
macros.doc: By using the command setRecipeLengths it is possible to change the (default) values for the picture widths and the text column widths.

macros.name: setRecipeSizes
macros.doc: The macro setRecipeSizes enables you to modify the font size of many parts of the recipe.
